agentTools.description: Query the local mirror of the 智小研 (PKU OpenAgent) public agent catalog: 86 public K12 subject agents with teacher/school, subject, grade, brief, description, welcome text, example questions, capability flags (knowledge base / voice / digital human / upload) and the list of published knowledge-base FILE NAMES. Public metadata only: file bodies are not stored. Use it when a question is about 智小研 agents, which agent to use for a topic, or what material an agent publishes. Always keep the returned source URL. Use ToolSearch before calling.
